versions.changelog:
Initial release of doccraft: a skill for creating professional, source-grounded documents and managing .docx workflows.

- Draft, edit, and review formal documents from various source materials (PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, etc.).
- Supports proposals, technical plans, implementation schemes, construction documents, reports, and other long-form deliverables.
- Provides structured workflows for both content generation (grounded text) and .docx file creation/editing, including tracked changes and comments.
- Emphasizes separation between drafting (Markdown/plain text) and final formatting (Word DOCX) for professional review and delivery.
- Contains guidance for both single-agent and multi-agent document projects, source manifest creation, section briefs, and consistency review.
